objects.name: configuration
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE configuration (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1), payload TEXT NOT NULL)

objects.name: correction_effects
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE correction_effects (
            run_id TEXT NOT NULL, group_id TEXT NOT NULL, ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL, payload TEXT NOT NULL,
            PRIMARY KEY(run_id,group_id,ordinal),
            FOREIGN KEY(run_id,group_id) REFERENCES correction_groups(run_id,group_id))

objects.name: correction_groups
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE correction_groups (
            run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES runs(id), group_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            correction_record_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES records(id),
            target_record_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES records(id), payload TEXT NOT NULL,
            PRIMARY KEY(run_id,group_id))

objects.name: evidence
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE evidence (run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES runs(id), evidence_id TEXT NOT NULL, payload TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(run_id, evidence_id))

objects.name: findings
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE findings (run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES runs(id), ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL, payload TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(run_id, ordinal))

objects.name: receipts
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE receipts (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, receipt_hash TEXT NOT NULL, record_id TEXT REFERENCES records(id),
 received_at TEXT, raw TEXT NOT NULL, error TEXT, status TEXT NOT NULL
)
